{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS262 |prevtitle=It All Ends Now III |nextcode=PS264 |nexttitle=It All Ends Now V |series=Ruby & Sapphire |colorscheme=Hoenn}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=It All Ends Now IV |subtitle=The Roar of Discipline |title_ja=最終超決戦IV |title_ro=The Final Battle IV |image=PS263.png |scheme=Ruby & Sapphire |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 263 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|22}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 263 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|22}} |location=[[Sootopolis City]] }} '''It All Ends Now IV''' (Japanese: '''最終超決戦IV''' ''The Final Battle IV''), titled '''The Final Showdown IV''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 263rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 83rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''The Roar of Discipline''' (Japanese: '''粛正の咆吼''' ''Roar of Enforcement'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Roar That Subdues''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} On top of {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}'s head, {{adv|Ruby}} notices the figure hidden behind the layer of ozone is his father, {{adv|Norman}}. As she lays dying, [[Courtney]] reveals that after her defeat at the [[Rusturf Tunnel]] she wanted to become Ruby's friend. Courtney reveals that in order to do this, she had to learn everything about Ruby, including that his father is the [[Gym Leader]] of the [[Petalburg Gym]]. Upon learning that Norman failed his Gym Leader inauguration test, she went to find out why he didn't retake the test in the five years since he initially failed it. Courtney reveals that Norman didn't retake the test because he was banned from doing so for five years and was forced to look for Rayquaza, which he had lost. She states that the [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman intended to use Rayquaza to subdue {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}}. Ruby, learning that with Rayquaza and the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s he and Norman can stop Groudon and Kyogre, jumps on top of Rayquaza. Ruby, in his head, thanks Courtney for her help and considers them comrades from the start because of their love for {{pkmn|Contest}}s. Ruby tries to talk to Norman, but when he is ignored, he decides to wait until the battle is over. Rayquaza flies above Groudon and Kyogre, at which point Ruby jumps off it. With the power of Rayquaza and the Red and Blue Orbs in hand, Ruby sends both Pokémon flying off [[Sootopolis City]]. Groudon and Kyogre, now calmed down, immediately leave to continue their long slumber. With the battle finally over, Ruby tries to apologize to his father about everything he's done. To Ruby's confusion, Norman just stands there, motionless and unresponsive. On top of {{p|Registeel}}, [[Wallace]] celebrates with {{Steven}} over Ruby's victory. Steven tries to agree with him, but suddenly collapses. Ruby and Wallace try to shake Norman and Steven, but neither get a response. From the rubble of the [[Cave of Origin]], two sets of eyes glow from within. ==Major events== * {{adv|Ruby}} learns the truth about why {{adv|Norman}} didn't retake the [[Gym Leader]] test five years ago. * Ruby teams up with his father to stop {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}}. * Kyogre and Groudon return to their slumber. * {{Steven}} and Norman suddenly become unresponsive. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Norman}} * [[Professor Birch]] (flashback) * [[Roxanne]] * [[Brawly]] * [[Wattson]] * [[Flannery]] * [[Wallace]] * [[Steven Stone]] * [[Courtney]]/{{tt|Marge|Chuang Yi}} * [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] * [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman * [[Captain Stern]] * [[Dock]]/{{tt|Tuga|Chuang Yi}} * [[Mom (Hoenn)|Ruby's mother]] (flashback) * Old couple ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Kyogre}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre|Adventures}}) * {{p|Groudon}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon|Adventures}}) * {{p|Rayquaza}} ({{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza|Adventures}}) * {{p|Registeel}} ([[Brandon's legendary giants#Pokémon Adventures|Adventures]]) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|最終決戰IV|The Final Battle IV}} (Taiwan)
